metaDescription: Returns, exchanges and refund policy for Mudiyanse Auto Solutions orders.
heading: Returns & Refunds
subtitle: A plain-language summary of how we handle returns, exchanges and refunds.
intro: Every item is checked before it's dispatched.

otherProblems.heading: Wrong item, damaged in transit, or not as described
otherProblems.body: Report it from My Orders within {{days}} days of delivery, with photos of the item and its packaging. The seller responds within 2 days. If they decline, our team reviews the case and decides.

condition.heading: Condition
condition.body: Items must be unused and in their original packaging, except where the problem was our mistake or the item was damaged in transit.

refundMethod.heading: How Refunds Are Paid
refundMethod.body: Refunds are paid by bank transfer or cash once the returned item has reached us. Return shipping is decided case by case, and we tell you before you send anything back.
